clauses.text: The first delivery is walked by a bot that reads only the screen
the DELIVER ceremony walked by the screen-reading bot
In range of a destination the prompt list leads with a gold DELIVER plate
pressing it roots the walker and the crates leave the pack one by one
then "RECEIVED — N CRATES", then the slips, then the board
the tower on the walker's back empties crate by crate as the hand-over plays
